title: Cut rc2: tag, build, approve to the test feed

before.body: Push tag v6.1.0-rc2 from main and run release-approve.sh v6.1.0-rc2 on the Studio. Also build one rc signed with a throwaway update key and publish it to the test feed only for V-2's refusal check, then withdraw it. No files change.
